_comment: Example workload SLO definitions for app/operations/collectors/slo.py. Copy this file, edit the entries for your workloads, and point SLO_DEFINITIONS_PATH at your copy (or inline the 'slos' array as SLO_DEFINITIONS_JSON). Neither env var set = SLOs report an explicit not_configured state, never a fabricated uptime number. See docs/EVIDENCE_MODEL.md for the full field reference.

slos.query: AppRequests | where AppRoleName == 'checkout-api' | summarize total = count(), good = countif(Success == true)
AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.LOGIC' and Category == 'WorkflowRuntime' | summarize total = count(), good = countif(status_s == 'Succeeded')
